title: Deeper/broader standalone PLOTSETTINGS root and writer boundary
scope: Standalone PLOTSETTINGS dictionary root and owner identity
Smallest safe writer implementation and generated validation slice

method.kind: Read-only review of Autodesk DXF/API documentation, LibreDWG source mapping, and local writer/adapter boundaries
method.limitations: Documentation and source review establish the dictionary route but do not constitute a producer-authored sample, printer/device qualification, or semantic plotting acceptance. Current shade APIs and published DXF mode tables differ; non-null code-333 target closure remains unqualified.

sources.observed: PLOTSETTINGS DXF codes define handle, owner dictionary/object links, page setup name, plot settings fields, and optional code-333 ShadePlot ID/Handle. The published page lists shade modes 0-3.

Standalone PlotSettings objects are stored in the drawing PlotSettings dictionary; dictionary iteration returns named page setups, and creating a setup assigns PlotSettingsName then adds it to that dictionary. Layout derives from PlotSettings but is distinct because Layout has a BlockTableRecord.
Current shade-plot API includes object-referencing modes beyond the published DXF reference's 0-3 list; mode-specific target types must be resolved separately.
The DWG table/object mapping routes PLOTSETTINGS through the ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS dictionary. This is an independent implementation cross-check, not a normative serialization oracle.

dxfRW::writePlotSettings already emits the supported field set and owner group, and validates Custom DPI. dx_iface currently captures standalone records then refuses export; named dictionary-root closure and code-333 remapping are not yet wired.

assessment.qualifiedRoute: ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS named dictionary entry keyed by page setup name; the standalone object is owned by that dictionary.
assessment.unresolvedRoute: Non-null PLOTSETTINGS group-333 references: target class and valid target type vary with shade mode and product/version evidence.
assessment.safeInitialProfile: Null/omitted code 333 only, with otherwise qualified plot values; preserve full object data and reject unsupported/non-null reference cases atomically.
implementationReadiness: Preflight exactly one ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS NOD edge, unique matching dictionary, unique keyed object, and consistent owner handles.
Plan handle mapping before output and verify root entry, dictionary entry, record identity, and owner all use it.
Use existing dxfRW::writePlotSettings field serialization and test ASCII/Binary structural round-trip with generated vectors.
assessment.peerEvidenceRule: Use LibreDWG only as independent corroboration of root naming. It does not establish local writer correctness or semantic/consumer support.
